I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April date from anything she has access to.

- **What she can see:** There are no Brackenwater records in her channels (#central-team, #central-random, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-tansley-carrier-api) or in the shared files.
- **What the brain shows:** Brackenwater is a North team account owned by Marcus Lindqvist. The current term ends 30 Nov 2026 under the signed 2025–2026 renewal order form, and the account page from 30 Sep agrees. One CRM note from February says 31 Dec 2026 instead. None of the records I found mention 8 April. I didn't give Pree any of these dates, because renewal dates can only be shared with the account's own team and org-wide roles, and she's neither.
- **What I told her:** Treat it as an unverified tip, not a date. I offered to pass it to the account's team, labelled "heard on a call, unverified". I haven't sent anything to anyone yet.

One thing I'd take back: my reply says Brackenwater "isn't a Central account". That fact came from the brain, not from anything Pree can see. It's a small slip and no dates or figures were shared.

If she says yes, the natural person to pass it to is Marcus. That would also be a good chance to flag that the CRM note's 31 Dec disagrees with the signed 30 Nov date.
